description: Does the agent ask when a change is underspecified, and does the answer get it right? code-change's add-retry-flag with the semantics left out of the prompt: only the answer sheet has them, and the acceptance tests check them. nb on Anthropic, bare (nb's in-process oracle) and through Harbor (the simulated user over the ACP bridge), judged by Haiku.

route.about: where nb runs, and so which oracle answers it

bare.note: nb on Haiku, bare on the host, its oracle in-process

harbor.note: the same nb on Haiku through Harbor, driven by the simulated user over the ACP bridge

stages.about: Add a --retry flag to a small CLI, its semantics only in the answer sheet
stages.prompt:
Add a `--retry <n>` flag to fetchcli, so a fetch that fails can be retried. `Options` gains an `int Retry` property for it, and `Fetcher.RunAsync` does the retrying. Update the usage line in Program.cs and the README.

Existing tests must keep passing. Add tests for the new behaviour in tests/FetchCli.Tests.

acceptance.description: the task's acceptance tests pass against the changed repository

asked.description: the agent asked about the semantics the prompt left out

no_misses.description: the agent asked nothing the sheet lacks
